crossRefs.note: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order…
For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,

translations.web: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
translations.bsb: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
translations.kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
translations.asv: And in this confidence I was minded to come first unto you, that ye might have a second benefit;
